testcase.name: AI configuration is read locally and saving does not test the external service
AI organization sends only the provided statement and connection testing is a separate explicit request
AI cancellation aborts the actual request and preserves the cancellation message
AI timeout is longer than local backend generation and gives an actionable error
AI wrappers retain provider-facing errors returned safely by the local service
AI progress observes delayed response before completion, ignores startup 404 and stops polling afterward
failed status reads produce visible diagnostics without inventing provider progress or erasing a valid result
cancellation sends the independent backend cancel request immediately and rejects a late successful body
the frontend deadline truly cancels a tracked backend request instead of just hiding its spinner
cancel retries a registration race under the same independent deadline without starting another model request
cancelling during the final status query rejects the result and preserves the cancelled snapshot over a late running read
cancel registration retry stops at its total deadline and reports an unconfirmed cancellation
a slow in-flight status read is stopped before the final status query, so polls never overlap
explicit connection tests attach a request ID while retaining the existing no-input test contract
AI input excludes source images and independent notes, while retaining nested problem headings
fenced input retains exact whitespace and heading-like data during AI parsing
numbered standalone samples remain grouped and an optional Markdown envelope is removed
AI application preserves original images, unknown sections and omitted output
unstructured or empty AI output is rejected without inventing a section
older saved split sizes retain original display mode and remain untouched
mode and active editor survive JSON roundtrip without changing pane sizes
malformed display preferences cannot hide every editor
tab keyboard navigation wraps and Home/End selects deterministic editor
active pane filters only valid indices and leaves split mode ratios untouched
small image keeps its original resolution
large landscape image fits both viewport bounds without stretching
portrait image refits when the window gets smaller
hung image upload times out with a readable error
user cancellation aborts the actual request
image upload preserves backend validation errors
late RUNNING cancellation HTTP response cannot overwrite SSE CANCELLED terminal state
state and progress cannot regress when polling arrives after newer SSE
a terminal snapshot is accepted regardless of lagging interim progress metrics
late previous-job requests cannot overwrite a new job or a cleared problem view
explicit start and historical selections may display a different job
diff retains nonbreaking spaces that the judge considers meaningful
diff matches Java trailing whitespace and CRLF handling without dropping leading spaces
large UTF-8 preview is bounded while retaining complete short output
forced save waits for upload insertion and for another upload started while waiting
upload failure rejects an in-flight forced flush, preserving the close guard
recognition only sends local uploaded filenames to the backend

recognition timeout releases the request with actionable error
recognition retains the Windows language setup error returned by the service
image selection preserves document order, deduplicates and ignores remote images and fenced examples
exam screenshot selects the problem column and removes UI, watermarks and editor gutter
ordinary statements keep legitimate pseudocode and short sample numbers
focused enhancement keeps complete original bounds, timing and array rows without duplicating them
formatting joins wrapped prose but separates complete sentences and individual input rows
organizing Markdown preserves unknown headings, personal notes, images and exact fenced sample data
replacing messy OCR removes the original template boilerplate while preserving custom generator notes

title inference requires a larger first line and semantic headings
multiple screenshots continue a section and repeated ranges retain both content and coordinates
generic numbered examples scope vertical Input and Output labels to samples

side-by-side sample columns stay separate even with unequal line counts
explicit input/output format columns retain their semantics and separate bodies

merge edits the Markdown title and implicit description while preserving original screenshots
an explicit description takes precedence over arbitrary preamble and title notes

Markdown-looking sample data in code fences is never interpreted as a section boundary

replacing samples also replaces nested Input/Output headings without touching actual format sections
